propositions: The live tickets branch .bridge_state/projects.json was overwritten with rehearsal fixture keys LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO which do not exist in live Jira, causing Reconcile Bridge and Heartbeat Canary to fail on every run since 2026-08-15T02:39Z with 'project = LEG AND status != Done' JQL parse error.

Bridge-state write path (projects_store set/remove operations) lacks write lock, commit, and push semantics, forcing ad-hoc hand-commits on the live tickets branch that introduced the LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO corruption.

The canonical correct state for .bridge_state/projects.json is {version:1, legacy_default:REB, projects:{}} (empty projects dict); corruption was introduced via unauthorized direct git commits authored with test-fixture identity at 2026-08-14T19:18-0700, 21 minutes before first failure.
